Deal 08 · Spotlight
Extended opportunity
Victoria Falls Jazz Festival ’27
18 April 2027
Theme
Renaissance Rebirth
The ’27 edition takes its inspiration from Harari, the South African Afro-rock, funk and fusion group that began as The Beaters in the late 1960s and became Harari in 1976 during a tour of Rhodesia. A festival about reinvention, honouring a band that reinvented itself.
Target headline acts
Thandi Ntuli
Rebecca Facey
Somi
Balimaya Project
DJ Zinhle
More to be announced
